title: fix(service-i18n)!: retire I18nServicePlugin's own /api/v1/i18n/* mounts; the dispatcher bridge is the one owner (#23347)
body:
Fixes #23347
Clause-②: no

## What this does

`/api/v1/i18n/locales`, `/translations/:locale` and `/labels/:object/:locale` had two registrations: the dispatcher bridge's (`createDispatcherPlugin`, in its Phase 2 `start()`) and `I18nServicePlugin`'s (in a Phase 3 `kernel:ready` hook). This PR retires the plugin's copy, so each path has one owner, the dispatcher bridge (ADR-0076 D11: the `i18n` slot is multi-provider, so the route bridges to the slot, not to a package).

- `I18nServicePlugin` registers the `i18n` service and wires the runtime-authored translation sync. It mounts **no** HTTP route, and no longer looks up an HTTP server.
- `I18nServicePluginOptions.registerRoutes` and `.basePath` are **removed**. They only drove those mounts. Readers measured across the whole tree (examples, tests, docs, `../objectui`): none outside `service-i18n` itself. Positive control: the same grep finds the in-package uses. `os serve` (`serve.ts` step 3b) and `DevPlugin` pass only `defaultLocale` / `fallbackLocale`.
- **Negative pin**, in `i18n-service-plugin.test.ts`: given an HTTP server under both `http-server` and `http.server`, with every lifecycle event the plugin hooks fired, nothing lands on it (no verb, no `use`, no raw-app call). The i18n service is still registered. Ablated below.
- The handler-only tests (`error-envelope.conformance.test.ts`, `i18n-routes.server-fault-withheld.test.ts`) are deleted with the handlers they drove. The dispatcher's twin is covered in `packages/runtime` (for example `i18n-success-envelope.conformance.test.ts`). The `sendServerFault` conversion of the plugin arms (#23346) went with those arms. It protected nothing live on `os serve`: the measurement below shows those arms were never reached there.
- `i18n-route-ledger.ts` keeps its three rows, re-framed as wire data. It is **not** a list of routes this package mounts. Its conformance test keeps only the row hygiene. Why it was not deleted: see Acceptance notes.
- README: the package no longer says it mounts the routes. The REST section names the dispatcher as owner, and its anonymous floor. The options table drops the two options.

## Step 1: the boot that settles it (measured, not inferred)

Composition: `objectstack serve --server --log-level info` (no `--preset`) on `examples/app-showcase`, from this worktree's build. `OS_DATABASE_URL` is a scratch SQLite file, because a production-mode host config gets no default driver. Plugins composed include `I18nService`, `HonoServer`, `RestAPI` and `Dispatcher`.

| | before (`origin/main` 086fa4640) | after (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| boot log `I18n routes registered: …` (the plugin's line) | **present** (the precondition) | **absent** |
| anonymous `GET` ×3 | `401`, `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"UNAUTHENTICATED",…,"httpStatus":401}}`, `X-Request-Id` and `X-Content-Type-Options` present, on all 3 | identical |
| signed-in `GET /labels/showcase_task/zh` | `200`, `data.locale: "zh-CN"` (18 labels) | identical |
| signed-in `GET /translations/zh` | `200`, `locale: "zh-CN"`, `requestedLocale: "zh"` (11 bundle keys) | identical |

Both discriminators name the dispatcher on all three paths, before the change. The dispatcher envelope and headers are one. The other is the dispatcher's `resolveLocale` expansion of `zh` to `zh-CN`, where the plugin handler would have echoed `zh`. So the plugin's three registrations were mounted and never reached on `os serve`. After the change, the routes answer the same way, served from the same adapter the plugin still registers.

## Tests

Run at `6dc743667` (`origin/main` merged in), from `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-i18n …`:

- `test`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 57 passed (57)`.
- `typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` confirms the program reaches all four `*.test.ts`.
- `build`: exit 0. The built `dist/index.js` carries 0 occurrences of `I18n routes registered`.

**Ablation of the negative pin** (one-shot; nothing kept). Done through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under a restore trap, with the implementation committed first. The test imports the plugin by relative source path, so there is no `dist` leg.

- Mutation: in `start()`, a `kernel:ready` hook that does `ctx.getService('http-server').get('/api/v1/i18n/locales', …)`.
- Landed on disk: anchor 1 → 0, marker count 1, blob `d64ed0696c7c` → `e4e109401f6f`.
- Result: **red**, `AssertionError: expected [ 'server.get /api/v1/i18n/locales' ] to deeply equal []` (1 failed | 5 passed).
- Restored: blob back to `d64ed0696c7c` = HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The first attempt was a declared no-op. Its replacement still contained the anchor, so the tool refused (anchor 1 → 1) and nothing ran. The anchor was fixed and the leg re-run once.

## Gates

Local subset only. CI runs the full farm on this PR.

- **Derivation:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `6dc743667`. The change set is 10 paths against merge base `7ffc57846`.
- **Result:** **83 families, every one exit 0.** Each exit code was captured before any pipe and reconciled with `--ran`: "83 derived, 83 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 83 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- **Re-runs:**
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 (nothing measured): its pinned fixture commit is outside this shallow clone. Fetched, then 0.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3: eight unrelated packages had no `dist`. Built (all turbo cache hits), then 0. Its pass line: 110 require entry points across 68 packages load.
  - `check:pm-dispatch-gates` was run twice, so its exit code would be recorded. Fast tier: 1841 cases pass.
- **Reverse verification of the narrowed type**, against the rebuilt `dist/index.d.ts`: a probe calling `new I18nServicePlugin({ basePath: '/custom/i18n' })` fails with `TS2353 … 'basePath' does not exist in type 'I18nServicePluginOptions'`, and the same with `registerRoutes: false`. The control `new I18nServicePlugin({ defaultLocale: 'en', fallbackLocale: 'en' })` compiles.
- **Downstream:** no package outside service-i18n names `I18nServicePluginOptions` or constructs the plugin through a typed import. `serve.ts` and `DevPlugin` load it dynamically. The only static importers, two `plugin-security` tests, import the unchanged `FileI18nAdapter`. So no consumer test is owed for the narrowed members.

## One edit outside the claimed file surface

`scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs`, one line. Its shrink-only registry entry for `@objectstack/service-i18n` narrowed from `['@objectstack/core', '@objectstack/spec', '@objectstack/types']` to `['@objectstack/core', '@objectstack/spec']`. This is the gate's own prescription ("registry entry is STALE — no longer unaliased: @objectstack/types. Narrow the entry to exactly: …"). It follows from deleting the handler-only fault test, the package's last test importing `@objectstack/types`. Without it, `check:test-source-alias` is red.

## Changeset

`@objectstack/service-i18n: minor`, with `**BREAKING**` and a `!` summary. It is breaking because it narrows a published runtime interface: `I18nServicePluginOptions` loses two members. It also narrows routing in a composition that serves HTTP without the dispatcher. It ships as `minor` under the launch-window convention (`check-changeset-no-major`). ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (runtime-interface-only …#I18nServicePluginOptions)`. No spec key, Zod schema or stored shape moves, so `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite. The precedent is `.changeset/pre/22345-run-provenance-context-retired.md`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The service-i18n ledger is now a duplicate, and its consolidation is a follow-up, not this PR.** The dispatcher ledger (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`) carries the same three routes. Deleting `i18n-route-ledger.ts` means editing its readers, all outside this claim's surface:
  - `packages/client/src/{client-url-conformance,route-ledger-response-schema,service-route-ledger-coverage}.test.ts`;
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`;
  - two `globs` entries in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`;
  - `scripts/check-route-ledger-census.mjs`'s measured duplicate count;
  - three mentions in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{api-backend,i18n}.json`.

  `service-route-ledger-coverage`'s "the whole `i18n` namespace is backed by a ledger row" would read the dispatcher rows instead. The ledger header says all this, so no row reads as evidence of a mount meanwhile.
- **Comments elsewhere still describe the plugin as a route owner.** Out of surface, prose only, behaviour-neutral:
  - `serve.ts` step 3b ("ensures i18n REST routes work out of the box");
  - `packages/client/src/index.ts` (the `getTranslations` docblock: "service-i18n's autonomous routes");
  - `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` headers;
  - `packages/rest/src/openapi-builtin-paths.ts`;
  - `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`, whose `MODULES` row for `i18n-service-plugin.ts` (`0 / 0 / 0`, still green) no longer names a route module.
- **Harness and serve parity, answered.** `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack` composes no `I18nServicePlugin`, but its i18n routes come from the same dispatcher bridge. So the `anonymous-deny-i18n` dogfood proof now covers the same, and only, route owner as `os serve`. The remaining difference is the slot's provider (the in-memory fallback there, the file adapter on serve), not the route owner. `packages/verify` is not touched.
- **ADR-0076 OQ#9** says the dispatcher alone owns i18n and storage in a standard boot. It goes in a separate docs-only draft PR, because `docs/adr/**` is Tier H. That way this PR lands on its own.
